summary: Post-merge non-regression test of the 5 lots. Backend: 19/19 pytest pass after one fix (18/19 before). Checked: admin login/JWT, KPIs (revenue_usd=700, total=2, done=1, submitted=1), /api/config fields, HEAD /api/config (200, 0 bytes), auth guard on admin endpoints. LOT1: /admin/applications pagination, page_size cap (1001 gives 422, 1000 gives 200), search, date filters. LOT2: /admin/transactions shape and filters, detail endpoint (200/404), CSV headers. LOT5: XLSX has 2 sheets and 13 columns. LOT3: the 3 email templates exist. LOT4: all indexes exist and key_unique_1 is unique. Frontend (Playwright, 1920x1080): admin login, dashboard showing GH-2026-318639 and GH-2026-204806, the lazy-loaded /admin/payments page (route-loading fallback seen, HUBTEL 700 USD card, status counts, 2 rows), both export downloads, the detail modal with raw JSON, the provider/status/search/date filters, the other lazy admin routes. No console errors. WhatsApp widget, Abena chat (AI reply about the $350 price) and the full Apply flow (home card, apply form, 4 uploads, /payment/{tracking} with Hubtel and 2 USDT buttons) all work.

minor.issue: Summary sheet COUNTIFS formula used LibreOffice syntax 'Transactions.G:G' instead of Excel syntax 'Transactions!G:G'. Excel would show #NAME? or a repair prompt. FIXED by the testing agent in transactions_service.py line 401.
Returns a bare list with no total or has_more. The frontend cannot show page counts. This was likely kept on purpose for backward compatibility; consider an X-Total-Count header.

Dedupe is check-then-upsert, so two webhooks arriving at the same time can both pass the find_one and both send. The unique index does not stop it because both upsert the same key. Use an atomic find_one_and_update with status != 'sent'. Also, when no admin recipients are set, the entry is marked 'failed' with 'all 0 recipients failed'.
Backend logs InsecureKeyLengthWarning: the HMAC key is 9 bytes. Use a JWT secret of 32 bytes or more in production.
to_list(100) limits the list to 100 templates (11 now). Not a problem today.

ui_bugs.issue: There is no 'Payments' entry in the admin sidebar. /admin/payments only opens by typing the URL. Add { to: '/admin/payments', label: 'Payments', icon: CreditCard } to NAV in AdminLayout.jsx.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 2540 lines. Split the admin, payments and public routers into modules.

transactions_service loads every application, hubtel_callback and crypto_payment into memory on each request, including the detail endpoint. This is fine now but will not scale. Push filters into Mongo queries and look up details by source key.
Date filtering compares ISO strings. This works because every value is a '+00:00' string. If any doc stores a datetime or a 'Z' suffix, it will silently fail the filter.
